nomic-embed-text:latest.name: Search Index
nomic-embed-text:latest.description: Not a chat model — pull this once to power the Reference Library's semantic search (the 📚 toggle in chat, and the Library tab's search). Tiny and fast; works regardless of whatever chat model you actually talk to.

qwen3.8:27b.name: Core Max
qwen3.8:27b.description: Dense 27B model with native vision+video support and large reported gains on coding/agentic benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench) over the previous Qwen generation; those specific numbers are Alibaba's own, not yet reproduced independently, but the generational jump is real. Still leaves room for long context on 24GB

deepseek-r1:32b.name: Logic Max
deepseek-r1:32b.description: The standard 24GB reasoning pick — full chain-of-thought at a size where quality stops being obviously limited by parameter count

qwen3-vl:32b.name: Eye Max
qwen3-vl:32b.description: Top-tier open vision-language model that fits a single 24GB card — strong OCR, document understanding, and detailed image description

hf.co/Stabhappy/gemma-4-31B-it-heretic-G.name: Unchained Max
hf.co/Stabhappy/gemma-4-31B-it-heretic-G.description: Gemma 4 31B, de-censored via the 'heretic' technique — keeps almost all of the base model's reasoning (MMLU barely drops) while refusing nothing. Pulled via Ollama's Hugging Face bridge (hf.co/...); confirm the exact quant tag on the repo page before pulling

qwen3-coder:30b.name: Dev Max
qwen3-coder:30b.description: Best quality-per-GB coding model on 24-32GB — MoE with only 3.3B active params so it's fast despite the size, 256K context, built for agentic tool-calling workflows

hf.co/bartowski/cognitivecomputations_Do.name: Muse Max
hf.co/bartowski/cognitivecomputations_Do.description: Dolphin 3.0's flagship — refusal-free fine-tune with the broadest creative range of any 24GB-class writing model. Pull via Ollama's Hugging Face bridge (confirmed bartowski quant repo)

hf.co/bartowski/cognitivecomputations_Do.name: Ranger Max
hf.co/bartowski/cognitivecomputations_Do.description: Dolphin's reasoning-tuned flagship: refusal-free like the Creative pick above, plus ~800K chain-of-thought traces bolted on — so it can work through a multi-step survival problem (diagnosing a symptom, troubleshooting an off-grid electrical fault) instead of pattern-matching an answer, and it won't hedge on the medical/defensive/improvised-chemistry questions a safety-tuned model will. Pull via Ollama's Hugging Face bridge

qwen2.5:32b.name: Ranger Max Knowledge
qwen2.5:32b.description: The knowledge-breadth alternative to the Dolphin pick above — largest dense general-knowledge model that fits 24GB, distinct from the newer Qwen3.6 General pick, but still safety-tuned so it will occasionally decline. Reach for this on encyclopedic questions (canning times, wiring gauges); reach for Ranger Max above when the topic is one a filter would flag
